payload.description: Upstream bmad-method 6.10.0 installer, on --yes reinstall over an existing install, re-serializes list-valued module config options as JSON strings (e.g. primary_platform [a,b] becomes a quoted string) and rewrites all installed files with LF endings, producing large no-op git churn. Versions stay at pin; churn must be reverted or normalized after verify.
